title: P1912 – Kickdown Hold Relay Open or Short Circuit to Ground
description: Kickdown Hold Relay Open or Short Circuit to Ground
symptoms: Check engine light or stored DTC present
Driveability or system warning may accompany this code
causes: Component or circuit fault related to this monitor
Wiring, connector, or control module issue
solutions: Verify the code with a quality OBD-II scanner and note freeze-frame data
Inspect related components and wiring before replacing parts
Clear codes only after repair and confirm monitors complete
keywords: kickdown hold relay open or short
